_doc: Facts read from the firms' OFFICIAL pages, saved by get_prop_rules.bat on the user's PC on 2026-10-30 (research_data/prop_pages/<firm>/2026-10-30/, sha256 in index.json). 'verified' = the quoted sentence is on the saved official page. Firm-wide rules are stored as a 'firm policy' rule set and apply to every account type of that firm.

facts.quote: Yes. HyroTrader allows trading bots, as long as the strategy is your own.
